events.label: founding
events.text: Tyne and Wear PTE (Nexus) replaced the Tyneside PTE as executive body.

evidence.quote: It replaced the Tyneside PTE on 1 April 1974 .

events.text: Nexus launched a Bus Strategy to improve the Tyne and Wear bus network.

evidence.quote: In April 2009 Nexus launched a Bus Strategy aimed at improving the bus network in Tyne and Wear

events.label: policy decision
events.text: North East Combined Authority accepted Nexus recommendation for a Quality Contracts Scheme.

evidence.quote: In October 2014 the North East Combined Authority accepted a recommendation from Nexus to
take forward a Quality Contracts Scheme as the best means of meeting this objective .
